subject: Coordinate trial launch and prompt validation slotting
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@novapulse.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery recap + next steps to schedule trial work

Hi Sam — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so we can book the evaluation sprint: 

1) Problem statement: Surface high-confidence charting suggestions from clinical notes at discharge (reduce coder review time).
2) Success criteria (what you told us): 85% precision on top-1 suggestion for the 3 targeted diagnoses; average inference latency < 120ms p50 for 512-token requests; ability to validate on a 1k prompt sample.
3) Scope for trial: 2-week evaluation, 2 models (optimized fp16 and quantized), integration via S3 payloads + sample dataset you provide.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Book a 60-min evaluation kick-off (we’ll do architecture + trial plan + prompt set handoff).
- Share a 1k prompt sample and a short list of must-have success metrics in HubSpot (I linked below).
- Internal: I’ll loop in Soojin to scope the engineering deep dive and Marissa to own success criteria tracking.

Available slots (PST):
- Tue Nov 17: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed Nov 18: 09:00–10:00 or 16:00–17:00

Attachments: novapulse-trial-plan-v1.pdf (proposal), prompt-set-sample.csv (example).

If none of those times work, tell me two preferred windows and I’ll match with Soojin.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood-inference.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@novapulse.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@novapulse.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 12:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery recap + next steps to schedule trial work

Ben — thanks for the clear summary. Priya and I reviewed internally and we’re aligned with the success criteria you captured. 

Good to proceed with the 2-week trial and the datasets: we’ll provide the 1k prompt sample and a small labeled subset for validation. For kickoff, Wed Nov 18 16:00–17:00 PST works for both of us.

A couple quick asks before the call: 
- Can you share a short checklist of what our infra team should have open (IP ranges, S3 structure, service account permissions)?
- We’d like a short section in the kickoff on how you’ll measure inference stability across model variants.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.
Sam
Sam Jenkins
Head of Clinical AI | Novapulse Health
sam.jenkins@novapulse.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery recap + next steps to schedule trial work

Sam — perfect, Wed Nov 18 16:00–17:00 PST is locked. I’ve added Soojin and Marissa on the thread so they can prep the kickoff agenda: 

Planned 60-min agenda:
- 0–10m: Introductions + objectives alignment (Ben)
- 10–25m: Architecture & data exchange (Soogin)
- 25–40m: Trial mechanics (models/quantization, autoscaling, observability — Soojin)
- 40–50m: Success metrics, validation plan, prompt sampling (Marissa)
- 50–60m: Action items & timelines (Ben)

Sam — to answer your infra checklist ask, I’m attaching a short IP/S3/service-account checklist and I’ll paste the items below for easy copy: 
- Allowlist IPs: 34.200.12.0/24, 34.200.13.0/24
- S3 layout: s3://novapulse-trials/{dataset,inputs,labels}/
- Service account: trial-runner@novapulse-ops.iam (read-only on inputs + write for results)
- DocuSign/PO: If procurement needs a SOW we can attach one after kickoff.

Marissa — can you prepare the prompt-validation template (we’ll use a 1k sample, with a 100-record labeled holdout)? Also flag any additional metrics beyond precision/latency you recommend (e.g., coverage, hallucination rate).

Attachments: novapulse-trial-plan-v1.pdf (re-attached), infra-checklist.txt (stub).

Thanks all — calendar invite coming from Soojin.
Ben
